identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][demo] Remediate flagship Observatory render artifacts and presentation proof

values.summary: Bind a fresh FastWork issue worktree, prove Unity/MCP project identity, capture and classify the current visual defects, correct the responsible scene and staging surfaces, retain fresh dual-resolution proof, run focused validation, and obtain exact-head review before publication.

steps.action: Bind #5683 and prove the intended Unity project, MCP endpoint, flagship scene, and current baseline
Identify and remove the objects, materials, particles, or lights causing the visible cyan and green artifacts
Repair camera composition, terrain continuity, architecture grounding, lighting, and material hierarchy
Verify the fixed operator shell and fail-closed Runtime v3 presentation at both target resolutions
Retain direct dual-resolution proof, run focused validation, and publish a truthful proof index
Run bounded exact-head review, fix actionable findings, and publish only after review passes

invariants: Project and scene identity are proven before mutation
Licensed assets remain external and untracked
The first Play Mode view reads as a deliberate Observatory
The dashboard is fixed and only intended internal panels scroll
No player or replacement owner binary is built
risks: The artifact may originate in an operator-provisioned licensed prefab or material that is not stored in Git
The live Unity editor may be attached to a stale project copy or MCP endpoint
Camera and lighting corrections may expose additional staging voids at QHD
UI Toolkit scaling may regress while the scene presentation is adjusted
stop_conditions: The live Unity editor is attached to a different project than the intended FastWork Observatory
MCP project identity cannot be proven or mutation targets are ambiguous
Unity compile errors prevent safe scene mutation
A required fix would copy or publish licensed asset payloads
A required change would widen into Runtime v3, Unity-MCP, or unrelated release-tail scope
